title: Art Type
description: An album cover made of its own pixels. Move across it and every pixel lifts off on its own arc and lands in the letters of the title, set as a poster in the cover's colours; move back and the picture puts itself together again. Left alone it breathes between the two.
intent: One morph finished to the edge: a particle reassignment from cover pixels to title glyphs, swept left to right, scrubbed by the pointer or a slider and springing to wherever you leave it.
